title: Quick Roasted Algerian Carrot Tagine
description: A flavorful and flaky vegetarian dish featuring roasted carrots in a miso marinade, perfect for a hangover cure or a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped carrots to the bowl and toss to coat with the miso marinade.
Spread the carrots in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the carrots in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the carrots from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the roasted carrots hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Traditionally, tagine is served with crusty bread or over couscous.
This dish can be served as a side or as a main course.
